visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a massive, crowded stadium filled with fans wearing green jerseys and waving large green and white flags. The atmosphere is energetic. (2) A female creator in a green jersey stands in the crowd, screaming with joy and wide eyes, while a male creator stands beside her smiling. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of a car at night; the female creator is speaking excitedly toward the camera while the male creator gestures in the background. (4) Night street footage shows a line of white SUVs with fans leaning out of windows, waving team scarves and flashing hand signals under bright streetlights. (5) Back in the stadium, the camera captures a high-angle view of the green-clad crowd jumping and chanting in unison. The lighting is bright from the stadium floodlights. (6) The male creator is seen in a hallway and then a more exclusive section of the stadium, where he interacts with a man in a yellow security vest. (7) In the 'hardcore' fan section, the male creator joins the fans, drumming on a large green and white traditional drum and clapping his hands in high-energy rhythmic synchronization. (8) The scoreboard flashes '1-0' and later '2-2', surrounded by a jubilant crowd. (9) The final phase shows a dark night exterior with a damaged silver car, indicating a transition to a different event.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents an immersive travel experience in Saudi Arabia, specifically focusing on the intense football culture and fan passion. It aims to entertain and inform viewers by showing first-hand access to a high-energy local stadium atmosphere, including interactions with passionate supporters and 'hardcore' fan sections.
